name: Platinum Vape 510 Cartridge | Zen Sauce
description: Zen Sauce is your flavorful fast-pass to inner peace—with just enough kick to keep things interesting. This smooth and balanced hybrid blends herbal sweetness, mellow citrus, and a hint of pine for a taste that’s clean, calm, and just a little mysterious. The high? A perfect yin-yang mix of mental clarity and body ease, like meditating on a hammock... with a side of giggles.
